propositions: LLMUnavailableError raised during epic-close bug screen is degraded to verdict C instead of propagating, causing systematic provider outages to silently blind the caused-by bug floor with no signal in verdict, sidecar, or exit code

per-candidate exception handling in epic_bug_screen.screen_candidates._row and run_screen's advisory shield swallows LLMUnavailableError before it can surface, contrasting with the absent-provider path which correctly fails closed
max_tokens ceiling set for a 128K model is never re-clamped when model shrinks to 64K haiku, causing Bedrock ValidationException 400 on every screen call

the completion verifier must fail-closed (nonzero exit, error naming provider failure, ticket stays in_progress) when LLMUnavailableError occurs, matching absent-provider behavior and consistent with --force-close escape hatch

re-raising LLMUnavailableError at both the warm-call and fan-out layers is necessary because completion screen has no upstream tripwire like Pass-1, making the screen's own fan-out the only place systematic provider errors surface
